title: DAY 27/90
VECTOR CALCULUS
scenes.sub: Grad, div, curl & the big three theorems
scenes.voice: Day twenty seven of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, with eighty days left. Today, vector calculus: short questions, quick marks, if you know the identities.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Subject, engineering mathematics. Topic, vector calculus. It also powers fluid mechanics and heat transfer, which start right after this.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover gradient, divergence and curl, directional derivatives, line, surface and volume integrals, and the theorems of Gauss, Stokes and Green.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. The curl of any gradient is zero, and the divergence of any curl is zero. The maximum directional derivative equals the magnitude of the gradient.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Practice PDF on Telegram now. Test, seven to nine P. M.: take it via the link in our Telegram channel, or simply visit our website, on mobile or laptop.
